Frontend final run: admin button result showed '0 reclassified, 0 listings cross-tagged'; public /search?category=home&size=96 showed 96 cards, backed by API items from 6 primary categories and 58 secondary matches. Public /api/listings?limit=96 returned items across 9 primary categories.
rca_of_the_issue: The tested fix adds deterministic primary classification and stable secondary-category top-up instead of cloning rows. Repeated rebalance calls no longer drift: second and third runs returned zero reclassifications and zero cross-tags with identical counts_after. One transient UI run during live sync returned 0/2 cross-tags; a subsequent run returned 0/0, consistent with state changing while live sync was active.
